summary: Video-game adaptations of Paizo's Pathfinder tabletop setting, including Obsidian's digital card game, Owlcat's CRPGs, and a Gallowspire roguelite survivor spin-off.

entries.title: Pathfinder Adventures

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release where available.

primary.why: The PC release gives the clearest archive/capture route for Obsidian's digital adaptation of the Pathfinder Adventure Card Game, while the mobile versions remain useful portable routes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam/GOG if available; use iOS/Android for the original mobile-style experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a digital card-game adaptation rather than an Owlcat-style CRPG.

entries.title: Pathfinder: Kingmaker
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows Enhanced Plus route with DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with current patches.

primary.version: Pathfinder: Kingmaker Enhanced Plus / Definitive PC route
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable CRPG route. The console Definitive Edition is useful, but the PC version received Enhanced/Enhanced Plus updates and remains the best capture/mod route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC build with all desired DLC installed; use PS4/Xbox One Definitive Edition only for console play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Definitive Edition is convenient, but the PC route remains preferred for archive play.

entries.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous
entries.definitive_edition: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Enhanced Edition with all DLC on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with current patches and DLC.

primary.version: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous Enhanced Edition with complete DLC
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route, and the complete PC path includes the major post-launch DLC through A Dance of Masks. Console and cloud versions do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Enhanced Edition with all story/season-pass DLC installed and current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: The final major DLC, A Dance of Masks, completed the documented post-launch DLC set; revisit only if a later complete bundle changes platform content.

entries.title: Pathfinder: Gallowspire Survivors

primary.why: The game is documented as a PC/Steam release, so Windows is the complete and highest-fidelity route for this Pathfinder roguelite survivor spin-off.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam with current patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or alternate port is documented.
